verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an OpenAI-compatible API and Anthropic Messages API support, but no item mentions token streaming, server-sent events, or a stream parameter. Inferring streaming from general OpenAI compatibility would rely on outside knowledge. The WebRTC speech-out claim concerns real-time voice, not token streaming to an application, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream generated tokens back to my application as they are produced
